description: This file defines a PHP class `RequestResetPasswordController` within the OrangeHRM project. The class handles password reset requests, validating CSRF tokens, searching for the user, and logging password reset attempts. It implements a controller interface and uses traits for CSRF token management.

classes.name: RequestResetPasswordController
classes.description: Controller responsible for processing password reset requests, validating CSRF tokens, and initiating password reset procedures.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Provides an instance of ResetPasswordService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the password reset request, validates CSRF token, searches for user, and logs the reset request. Redirects to appropriate URL based on success or failure.
